QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Neighborly Competition
QuestInfo.0: Find out how other players are decorating their houses!
QuestInfo.1:
Why not visit your neighbors to see how they've decorated their houses? You might even make a new friend!


#b#e[Using the 'Visit Random House' Feature ]#n
 - You can visit a random player's house by clicking the #i3801394# button in the Home menu.
